mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, #{now}), rotated_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (revoked_at IS NULL OR rotated_at IS NOT NULL)
